dedupe_keys.name: vietnam ministry of transport catalogue of databases decision 380 qđ bgtvt 2024

description: Decision 380/QĐ-BGTVT of 3 April 2024 by Vietnam's Ministry of Transport issues the official catalogue of the ministry's databases and the duties of their owners. Contents: a list of shared databases (transport infrastructure, vehicles, drivers, transport businesses) and sector databases for roads (infrastructure, vehicles, drivers, licences, road assets, pavement management PMS, bridge management VBMS and cable-stayed bridge monitoring), maritime (infrastructure, ship registry, seafarers, search and rescue), aviation, inland waterways, rail, vehicle inspection, public services and project and planning management, each with its owner and operator. Coverage: national. Format and access: the decision is a free PDF on the VIMAWA site, which also links public lookups for ships, seafarers and inland vessels; the listed databases themselves are mostly internal. Licence and cost: free document; no licence stated. Caveats: in Vietnamese, and the maritime infrastructure and hydrographic portals did not answer the cloud session. Useful as a map of which national asset, bridge and vessel databases exist to request for capacity planning and network models of Vietnam's transport. No closely related Vietnamese record was found in the catalogue.
